scope: Paired real-poster occupancy sampler; same original pretrained weights/LoRA, all 4096 tokens, 12 original steps and 22 model evaluations, same CPU-generated image conditioning and dedicated seed-123 noise. Only real-pair RoPE changes.
timing_scope: Resident weights and preuploaded conditions; input/output transfer, synchronized model calls, original CPU Euler/CFG arithmetic and instrumentation. Preparation, CPU reference, compilation/warmups and artifact I/O excluded.
decision: Do not promote to a quality-preserving default. Candidate is 4.14x faster over the full real-image sampler, but candidate-vs-stock TT final relative L2 is 29.4% and both TT variants are about 74.8% from FP32. Similar errors against FP32 do not imply agreement with each other.
next: Decode both through the same CPU occupancy decoder and calibrate real-image CPU pipeline precision. Continue first-block operator diagnostics.
reproduce: Repeat stock command in ../028-stock-poster-occupancy/summary.json with --rope-mode real_pairs and a new output directory. Reuse sealed stock CPU cache after strict identity validation to shorten setup.
